verdict.rationale: Fireflies exposes a GraphQL API (transcripts/transcript queries) that lets a user programmatically pull structured meeting data in JSON, and this is confirmed live and reachable in the runtime probe, giving a technical path to self-export. However, there is no documented bulk 'export all my data' feature, no mention of standard open export formats (CSV/JSON dump, GDPR-style account export), and no evidence of a data-portability or account-deletion export workflow for someone wanting to fully leave the platform. missing for 10: a documented full-account data export/portability feature, explicit open-format (CSV/JSON) bulk export tool, and evidence of an easy 'leave and take everything' workflow beyond ad-hoc API queries.
